headline: NYY @ CLE matchup research
quickWriteup: The current model score is NYY 3.65 at CLE 3.03, with a projected total of 6.68. Movement read: The side movement strengthened toward CLE: NYY moved -1.15 runs while CLE moved +0.55, changing the projected margin by -1.70 runs. The projected total fell -0.60, which points to a lower-run game script than the earliest saved read. NRFI probability rose +11.2%, so the first-inning read became more pitcher-friendly early. Pitching context: Carlos Rodón has the better recent run-prevention profile in the available outing logs at 1.6 ER over the last 5 outings. Batter research is strongest for Paul Goldschmidt, José Ramírez, Ben Rice, based on recent hit rates, matching location/opponent samples, or similar-game production. The cold/risk list flags Stuart Fairchild because the recent hit profile or strikeout trend is weaker than the projection alone would show.
